caption:
Your brain doesn't distinguish between imagining a disaster and remembering one. That's why tomorrow already feels like it went wrong. The Draft Delete empties the rough draft so your brain stops editing it.

The Draft Delete is from the free 7-Day Overthinking Detox — DM "DETOX" to get it.

Save this for the next night before something big. Send it to someone who pre-writes every failure.

#overthinking #anxiety #catastrophizing #mentalhealth #arajournals
hook: my brain wrote tomorrow's disaster report.
